relations.subject: Samuel Beal
relations.evidence: He graduated from Trinity College, Cambridge in 1847.

relations.subject: Samuel Beal
relations.evidence: From 1848 to 1850 he was headmaster of Bramham College, Yorkshire.

relations.subject: Samuel Beal
relations.evidence: In September 1872 he was appointed to examine the Buddhist Chinese books in the India Office Library, London.

relations.subject: Samuel Beal
relations.evidence: He retired from the navy in 1877, when he was appointed Professor of Chinese at University College, London.

relations.subject: Samuel Beal
relations.evidence: He was awarded DCL (Durham) in 1885 "in recognition of the value of his researches into Chinese Buddhism."
